name: Object Space Sampling via Gradient Integration and Directional Newton-Raphson
definition: A two-step process to find isosurface points for polynomial data. First, uniformly distributed seeds are guided along the gradient field via integration to get closer to the isosurface. Second, Directional Newton-Raphson (NR) is applied to refine the projection onto the isosurface.
summary: This method finds isosurface points by integrating gradients to guide seeds, ensuring reliable directional Newton-Raphson convergence in object space.
